definition-changed.flag: class | of a data item; source unit
definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.34) defines class of a data item by PICTURE/USAGE, a predefined identifier or an intrinsic function, as 2023 3.33 does in its note; this rule's 'class' is the object-oriented class (4.33/4.36), not a data class, so the difference reaches nothing the rule governs. §2002:4 (4.173) source unit runs from an identification division to an end marker 'including any contained source units', which 2023 3.165 carries as a note: the same outer level of a source unit that defines a class.
